abilities.name: Spawn Creep Tumor
abilities.text: Set a Creep Tumor token in base-to-base contact with this Unit.

abilities.name: Transfusion
abilities.text: Use when another Friendly Biological Unit (including a Structure) suffers Damage Within 4″. Reduce the Total Damage before allocation by 2.

abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.text: Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4″ receives a DEBUFF. Remove all DEBUFFS from it.

abilities.name: Psionic Link
abilities.text: Once per Round, if there are at least 7 Friendly models Within 6″ of this Unit, it may resolve its Special Ability with the BM cost reduced by 1.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (4) 3+ effect.

upgrades.name: Creep Speed
upgrades.text: While this Unit is ON CREEP, increase this Unit's Speed characteristic by 2.

upgrades.name: Domineering Presence
upgrades.text: Select another Friendly Unit Within 6″ (Line of Sight is not required). That Unit's Supply characteristic is increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers and completing objectives.
